_doc: ORDER-834 B1 investment branch, years 1-2. Read only by systems/InvestBranchBeats.gd. A beat plays on a free full-story week, in ledger order, at most one per MIN_GAP_WEEKS, only for a run that opened the branch (gate flag) and only inside its window. `portfolio`: true needs a holding, "loss" needs the holdings under water. `housing` matches GameState.housing. `after` names a beat that must already have played. Money moves only through each event's market_buy/market_sell choices.
